root_cause.text: The `sbc_execute_unmap()` function in the SCSI target core fails to check for integer overflow when adding the Logical Block Address (LBA) and the range, allowing a 64-bit wrap-around to bypass the device capacity bounds check.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of the `lba + range < lba` check in `drivers/target/target_core_sbc.c` before comparing the sum against the device's block count (`dev->transport->get_blocks(dev) + 1`).

bic_trace_step.reason: The function `sbc_execute_unmap` contains the vulnerable check on lines 668-671: `if (lba + range > dev->transport->get_blocks(dev) + 1)`. Here, `lba` (a 64-bit value) and `range` (a 32-bit value) are added together without checking for integer overflow. If `lba + range` overflows, it wraps around and can bypass the device capacity check, leading to an out-of-bounds access.
